articles.title: Delta Air Lines Selects GE Aerospace GEnx Engines to Power New 787-10s
articles.mainIdea: Delta Air Lines Selects GE Aerospace GEnx Engines to Power New 787-10s
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Delta Air Lines Selects GE Aerospace GEnx Engines to Power New 787-10s. GE Aerospace (NYSE:GE) announced today that Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) has selected GEnx engines to power 30 new Boeing 787-10s with options for 30 more aircraft. The agreement also includes spare engines and long-term services support. Related tickers mentioned: DAL.
